definitions.explanation: Pellets of ice that fall from cumulonimbus clouds during storms. Larger than sleet, and can cause damage to crops and property.

examples.japanese: {雹|ひょう}で{車|くるま}のボンネットがへこんだ。
examples.english: The car hood got dented by the hail.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{夕立|ゆうだち}で{大粒|おおつぶ}の{雹|ひょう}が{降|ふ}り、{農作物|のうさくぶつ}に{被害|ひがい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Large hailstones fell during a summer evening shower, causing damage to crops.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {霰|あられ}: sleet/graupel (smaller ice pellets, under 5mm)
- {雹|ひょう}: hail (larger ice pellets, 5mm or more)

The meteorological distinction is based on size: ice pellets under 5mm are classified as {霰|あられ}, while those 5mm and above are {雹|ひょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雹|ひょう}が{降|ふ}る: hail falls
- {雹|ひょう}の{被害|ひがい}: hail damage
- {大粒|おおつぶ}の{雹|ひょう}: large hailstones
